description: Implementation of the SI scheduler for 5G NR, managing scheduling of System Information messages, handling SI change requests, and scheduling short messages for paging.

classes.name: si_scheduler
classes.description: Class responsible for scheduling System Information messages, handling SI change requests, and managing paging notifications in a 5G NR network.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Executes scheduling logic for a given slot, including handling pending requests and scheduling SI messages.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the scheduler, resets internal state, and stops subordinate schedulers.

methods.name: handle_pending_request
methods.description: Handles any pending SI change requests, scheduling short messages or applying updates as needed.

methods.name: handle_si_update_request
methods.description: Receives and stores new SI scheduling update requests.

methods.name: try_schedule_short_message
methods.description: Attempts to schedule a short SI message in the current slot if conditions permit.

methods.name: allocate_short_message
methods.description: Allocates resources for a short SI message, specifically for paging notifications.
